prompts.closed:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished high-fidelity design preview for the existing Android app Read Assist. This is a proposed reader bottom-panel revision, not a marketing poster. Landscape 2048x1536 canvas with two equally sized complete Android phones side by side on a quiet warm cream background. Small captions outside phones: "PDF view" over left, "Text view" over right. Small unobtrusive footer outside phones: "Design preview · Sample content". Native practical UI, crisp text, no glossy effects. Warm Library app theme: ivory #F8F4EC, panel #FFFCF5, forest green #214F3A, dark ink #192B22, borders #D8D4C7. Serif document headings, clean sans-serif controls. Phones identical dimensions and same scale, clearly visible bottom panels, comfortable realistic medium controls.

Both phones show the exact same fictional document at page 42. Top Android status bar then small reader toolbar: back arrow, title "The Art of Attention", subtitle "Page 42 of 180", "Aa" button, vertical overflow dots. No Library/Voices/Settings navigation in this reader.
Left reading area: original PDF page on cream workspace, fine page boundary, modest serif title "A little room to think", smaller original-layout paragraphs and a quiet horizontal hairline; show authentic page layout with margins. Right reading area: the same text reflowed at a larger comfortable serif size, no PDF page border. Body sample text: "A quiet moment can change the shape of a day. We notice the light at the window, the sound of a turning page, and the space between our thoughts." Then "Reading asks us to slow down. One sentence leads to another, and attention finds its rhythm." Plenty of readable content, avoid filler UI messages.

CRITICAL BOTTOM PANEL DESIGN, IDENTICAL GEOMETRY ON BOTH PHONES:
One full-width warm ivory dock anchored directly above Android gesture safe area, soft rounded upper corners, subtle top edge. Medium height around 120dp, not a large console.
First dock row: a centered compact horizontal segmented control, 192dp wide and 48dp touch height, exactly two equal halves with labels "Text" and "PDF". On LEFT phone PDF half selected in dark forest green with white text, Text half pale. On RIGHT phone Text half selected green with white text, PDF half pale. Both labels always visible. No extra drag-handle strip above it.
Second dock row: FIVE EXACTLY EQUAL-WIDTH aligned slots spanning the panel, with control centers at 10%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90% of available width. From left to right: text "1×" speed button; previous-sentence icon (vertical bar and left triangle); filled forest-green circular Play button 58dp diameter with white triangle EXACTLY CENTERED ON PHONE; next-sentence icon (right triangle and vertical bar); a clearly visible upward chevron icon to expand controls. Up-chevron is visually simple, not an upload arrow or triangle-in-circle. Icon tap areas48dp, icons24-28dp. Equal gutters, same vertical center for all five controls. No labels below icons, no decorative extra buttons, no audio progress bar, no status/error text, no extra row, no floating playback widget. Android gesture bar below panel with safe spacing.
Focus on accurate layout: central Play mathematically at 50% of screen; speed and up-chevron mirror one another, previous and next mirror one another. PDF/Text is centered above. Do not omit or relocate the up-chevron.
prompts.expanded:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished high-fidelity portrait Android app UI mockup for Read Assist, Warm Library theme. 1024x1536 canvas: one complete phone centered on a quiet cream background; small outside caption at top "Reader controls expanded"; footer outside phone "Design preview · Sample content". Colors ivory #F8F4EC, surface #FFFCF5, forest green #214F3A, dark ink #192B22, muted surfaces #F6F1E8. Practical native Compose UI, crisp readable text, restrained borders and rounded cards, no glossy effects.

Visible near screen top behind dimmed scrim: reader toolbar "The Art of Attention" / "Page 42 of 180" and a short glimpse of the document. Above the bottom controls an expanded modal sheet occupies about85% of the app area. Rounded upper corners, tiny drag handle, heading "Reader controls", subtitle "Page 42 · Quick settings", close X at top right. Tabs "Quick" (selected, forest-green underline) and "Advanced". Vertically scrollable settings area, natural medium spacing and full-width cards; do not cram every option into view.
Show a card "Reading light" with "Brightness" and value "65%", a slider, row "Use phone brightness" with switch off, separator, "Warm light" switch on, "Strength · 25%" and warm-light slider.
Next card "Speech processing effort" with three equal chips "Low", "Medium" (selected), "High".
Next card "Text recognition" with chips "Fast", "Balanced" (selected), "High"; small help text "Apply to saved pages in Advanced."
At bottom of scroll content partly visible compact card with selectors "Voice model" / "Kokoro" and "Voice" / "Heart". It is fine for some settings to scroll below; ensure main settings legible. No chart, fake accuracy percentages, diagnostic logs or added feature controls.

CRITICAL FOOTER: fixed bottom playback row under a thin separator, above Android gesture safe area. FIVE EXACTLY EQUAL-WIDTH aligned slots, centers at10%,30%,50%,70%,90% of available width. Left to right: "1×" speed; previous-sentence icon; forest-green circular58dp Play with white triangle EXACTLY AT PHONE CENTER; next-sentence icon; clearly visible DOWN chevron to close this sheet. Minimum48dp tap targets. Previous/next symmetrical, speed/downarrow symmetrical. No "Listening" text column, no duplicate playback controls, no second player, no PDF/Text toggle INSIDE the expanded modal. The collapsed reader underneath is obscured, so its dock is not separately visible. Only one Play button on the whole screen. Down arrow is a simple chevron,not a download icon.
Show enough of the phone safe area and gesture bar so panel is visibly complete and evenly aligned.
